physics_checks: Domestic refrigerator transfers heat from interior to same room, with additional electrical work released as heat
Evaporation absorbs heat; compressor compresses vapor using electricity; condensation releases heat; pressure reduction closes cycle
Open door increases thermal load, not room cooling
Fan gives perceived skin cooling, not removal of heat from the room
Motor may rest between cycles; actual inverter behavior varies
